research.title: Droplet formation dynamics in a T-junction via pulsed electrohydrodynamics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Numerical simulations based on the phase-field lattice Boltzmann method are employed to investigate droplet formation dynamics in a T-junction microchannel under pulsed electrohydrodynamics. research.title: Effects of sinusoidal pitch amplitude and phase on power extraction and pitching-energy exchange in a single-blade vertical-axis turbine mod
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Sinusoidal blade pitching can improve vertical-axis turbine performance, but whether a blade could follow the same motion passively depends on the energy exchanged through pitching. research.title: Eliminating Make-Whole Uplifts with a Minimum-Cost Uniform Price Adder

research.title: Energy spectra and cascade in the spin turbulence of a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the spin-interaction energy spectrum of spin turbulence in a driven spinor Bose-Einstein condensate.
